verdicts.reason: Both reduce the watercolour rose, the original's main image, to a thumbnail pushed against the right edge. Both also make the second PRAY bigger than the first, which breaks the parallel structure of the original. A is worse on spacing: its first PRAY is jammed against the divider, its second PRAY nearly touches the rose, and the gaps between items are uneven. B spaces things more evenly and keeps the rose clear, but its two PRAY words differ even more in size, and its text pairs float loosely instead of reading as tight groups.
